# PhysioFlow

> AI-powered physical therapy exercise program generator

PhysioFlow is a free web application that generates personalized physical therapy exercise programs. Users describe their pain, stiffness, or mobility issue in plain language, and the app creates a multi-week stretching and strengthening program with video demonstrations.

## Features

- AI-generated personalized exercise programs based on user-described symptoms
- Multi-week progressive routines (stretching and strengthening)
- Exercise video demonstrations from licensed physical therapists
- Local progress tracking (no account required)
- Runs entirely in the browser (privacy-preserving)

## URL

https://itzsid.github.io/physical-therapy/

## How to Use

1. Visit the site
2. Describe your pain or mobility issue (e.g., "lower back pain from sitting", "stiff neck and shoulders")
3. The AI generates a personalized multi-week exercise program
4. Follow the exercises with video guidance
5. Track your progress over time

## Target Areas

The app can generate programs for any body area including: neck, shoulders, upper back, lower back, hips, knees, ankles, wrists, elbows, and more.

## Tech

- React + TypeScript single-page application
- Uses Gemini AI for program generation
- No backend required - runs in browser
- Progress saved to browser localStorage
